record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare COIL: Arbok (2 stars, hp 130) and Ekans (1 star, hp 60); both maxPP 90, range 1, types POISON/DARK. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Applies LOCKED (requested 3000 ms) and then PARALYSIS (requested 3000 ms) to the cast target, then raises the caster's own ATK and DEF each by a raw 3/5/10/20 by stars (3 for 1-star Ekans, 5 for 2-star Arbok) through addAttack / addDefense with apBoost 1. No damage is dealt. The locked status is refused if the target is already locked, skydiving, rune-protected, IMMUNITY_LOCKED, or inside the post-CC cooldown, but the paralysis and the self buffs are not conditioned on it.

targeting.who: status: the cast target only; buffs: the caster
targeting.note: Single target; no area, no displacement.

geometry.shape: single target plus self; no area

declaredRaw.description: LOCKED 3000 ms and PARALYSIS 3000 ms on the target; ATK and DEF + table[stars-1] on the caster; no damage or heal

effects.scaling: see statusEffects and buffs: durations are not AP-scaled; buffs use apBoost 1 and the crit flag
effects.resolution: order: triggerLocked, triggerParalysis, addAttack, addDefense; each is independent of whether an earlier one was accepted.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit
statusEffects.applicationOrder: first, before the paralysis and the self buffs
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target is not already locked (no stacking, no refresh), is not skydiving, has no runeProtect, lacks IMMUNITY_LOCKED, and its ccCooldown is <= 0; applied duration = requested (halved if the target is enraged) after the target's duration reductions, rounded, and SETS the lock timer. While locked the target cannot move (canMove), cannot be forcibly moved (canBeMoved), cannot dodge basic attacks, and its range is forced to 1 (sent to the moving state first if it was not 1). When the lock ends the range is recomputed from baseRange (+ Wide Lens / Long Wand) and ccCooldown is set to at least 1500 ms, during which a new lock is refused.

statusEffects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit: the strategy leaves apBoost at its default false, so triggerParalysis does not multiply by (1 + AP/100)
statusEffects.resolution: not applied with runeProtect or IMMUNITY_PARALYSIS; STORM weather multiplies the duration by 1.3, then by (1 - 0.2 x ELECTRIC_QUARTZ of the target's player); then the target's duration reductions; the timer keeps the larger of the existing remaining time and the new request (rounded); a CHERI_BERRY holder eats the berry after a successful application. A paralysed target uses half speed for attacks and movement and cannot dodge basic attacks. It is independent of whether the lock was accepted.

buffs.scaling: addAttack(value, caster = itself, apBoost 1, crit): value = round(value x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the cast crit); then Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down on a positive value, since it is a buff on a unit holding the belt); then Twist Band does nothing for a positive value; atk = max(1, atk + value). Not permanent (permanent default false).
buffs.resolution: applied change = the value after those steps; the helper is applied each cast, so repeat casts stack. canCritByDefault is false, so crit needs ABILITY_CRIT.

buffs.scaling: addDefense(value, caster = itself, apBoost 1, crit): same helper steps as ATK (AP, crit, Big Eater Belt); def = max(0, def + value). Not permanent.
buffs.resolution: applied change = the value after those steps; repeat casts stack.

starBehavior.note: ATK and DEF buffs are indexed by the caster's stars; the 3- and 4-star values (10, 20, also the ?? fallback) are not reachable by these units' bare factory star counts. Status durations do not depend on stars.

record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP (90). A second cast on a target that is still locked cannot re-lock it, and after the lock ends it is refused for 1500 ms (ccCooldown); paralysis only extends if longer. The ATK and DEF buffs stack on every cast.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: LOCKED 3000 ms and PARALYSIS 3000 ms on the target; ATK +3 (Ekans) / +5 (Arbok) and DEF +3 / +5 on the caster. Applied durations = requested after the target-side reductions (enraged also halves the lock), or not applied at all when a guard blocks it. Applied buffs = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit, rounded, then Big Eater Belt x1.25 down on a belt holder; a Twist Band only acts on negative values.
